name: Network Globe

installDownloads.purpose: IP-to-country location data (DB-IP Lite, October 2026) used to place connections on the globe

attribution: Original Labyrispace code, inspired by the eDEX-UI network panel; no eDEX-UI code is used. Rendering: three.js (MIT). Land outline and country label positions: Natural Earth (public domain). Time zone coordinates: IANA tz database (public domain). Optional location database: IP Geolocation by DB-IP (https://db-ip.com), CC BY 4.0.
